propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store_mod, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and its siblings to binding_lifecycle which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the patch's blast radius narrowed and would not catch regressions in the moved operations.
The integration test's clock mock must be extended to patch _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules to restore the original oracle reach.
Unit-tier coverage exists via test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence which directly pins the no-stamp contract on the moved policy owner.
AC#2 requirement to drive the test RED via unconditional clear_absent stamp is unsatisfiable because clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency pass.
